examples.title: Create a collection

collection.description: A data collection determines the structure of data to be stored in a database.

collectionOperations.description: Collection operations supported. The listed operations can be performed on the collection itself.

enum.description: Allows updating the collection's structure, for example adding, updating, or deleting fields. If not included, the collection's structure can't be changed.
Allows deleting the entire collection. If not included, the collection can't be deleted.

collectionOperations.title: collectionOperations

dataOperations.description:
Data operations the collection supports. The listed operations can be performed on data the collection contains.

> **Note**: The `PATCH` and `BULK_PATCH` operations aren't currently supported.
dataOperations.title: dataOperations

regular.description: Maximum number of regular (non-unique) indexes allowed for this collection.
regular.title: regular

total.description: Maximum number of regular and unique indexes allowed for this collection.
total.title: total

unique.description: Maximum number of unique indexes allowed for this collection.
unique.title: unique

enum.description: [Collection](https://support.wix.com/en/article/velo-working-with-wix-app-collections-and-code#what-are-wix-app-collections) created by a Wix app when it is installed. This type of collection can be modified dynamically by that app (for example, Wix Forms).
Collection created by a Wix Blocks app.
Collection located in externally connected storage.

displayField.description: Field whose value the CMS displays to represent the collection item when referenced in a different collection.
displayField.title: displayField

displayName.description: Collection's display name as shown in the CMS. For example, `My First Collection`.
displayName.title: displayName

displayNamespace.description:
UI-friendly namespace of the Wix app with which the data collection is associated, such as Stores or Bookings.
Empty for all data collections not owned by Wix apps.
displayNamespace.title: displayNamespace

maxSize.description:
Maximum permitted number of items in an array field. Relevant for fields that hold arrays, such as those of type `ARRAY`, `ARRAY_STRING`, or `ARRAY_DOCUMENT`.

Default: No validation
maxSize.title: maxSize

minSize.description:
Minimum permitted number of items in an array field. Relevant for fields that hold arrays, such as those of type `ARRAY`, `ARRAY_STRING`, or `ARRAY_DOCUMENT`.

Default: No validation
minSize.title: minSize

max.description:
Maximum permitted value for a numerical field.

Default: No validation
max.title: max

min.description:
Minimum permitted value for a numerical field.

Default: No validation
min.title: min

maxLength.description:
Maximum permitted length for a text field.

Default: No validation
maxLength.title: maxLength

minLength.description:
Minimum permitted length for a text field.

Default: No validation
minLength.title: minLength

queryOperators.description: Query operators that can be used for this field.
queryOperators.title: queryOperators

sortable.description:
Whether the collection can be sorted by this field.

Default: `false`
sortable.title: sortable

groupName.description: If `group_name` is set, this field will not be present in query results. To retrieve this field, pass `group_name` value to `includeFieldGroups` parameter in query operations.
groupName.title: groupName

enum.description: Any role can request the field.
Special permission required to request the field.

displayName.description: Field's display name when displayed in the CMS. For example, `First Name`.
displayName.title: displayName

immutable.description:
Whether the field is immutable. An immutable field can be set once, but then cannot be updated.

Default: `false`
immutable.title: immutable

key.description: Unique identifier for the field. For example, `firstName`.
key.title: key

plugins.description: Additional optional plugins for the field.

isPrimary.description:
Transient input-only flag. When set to `true` during create/update, designates
this category field's group as the target for `_primaryCategory`. The flag is
not persisted; `_primaryCategory` remains the source of truth.

Default: `false`
isPrimary.title: isPrimary

internal.description:
Indicates an internal CMS field. The CMS does not display internal fields.

Default: `false`
internal.title: internal

plugins.title: plugins

readOnly.description:
Whether the field is read-only. A read-only field can't be changed.

Default: `false`
readOnly.title: readOnly

required.description:
Whether the field is required.

Default: `false`
required.title: required

systemField.description: Whether the field is a system field.
systemField.title: systemField
